transitions.note: all v1 rules (anims.json transitions) apply to the standard clips

fx.voxel: axis-aligned cubes; flame and embers emissive (HDR fireColour ramp of shaders/include/fx_volume_frag.glsl), smoke lit; sizes m, colours sRGB, life s
fx.inherits: anims.json fx (v1, approved): muzzle_flash.rifle for the carbine, shell_eject, footstep, body_fall

flame_stream.superseded: v1 particle description kept for reference; the preview and the engine use flame_volume (owner feedback 7b: volume style)
flame_stream.emitter: weapon muzzle (nozzle), direction weapon +Z; on while a clip with stream:'flame' plays, or between flame_start and flame_stop
flame_stream.range: about 8 m (ballistic, droops at the end)

size.note: chunky cubes, axis-aligned in world space (like the explosion voxels)

color.hdr: fireColour(k) of fx_volume_frag.glsl, k = age / life

flame_stream.jitter: per-voxel position noise 0.04 m and a 15 % brightness flicker per frame (hash of particle id + frame)
flame_stream.snap: positions snapped to a 0.06 m world grid when drawing (reads as voxels, not sprites)
flame_stream.endOfLife: each flame voxel becomes a smoke voxel (below) at its last position; if it hits the ground (y <= 0) or a wall first it becomes a ground_fire seed at the hit point

flame_tongue.look: v3 (owner: one continuous tongue of flame): gap-free 5 cm world-aligned voxels (character scale), exact-size cubes, a solid tapered core along the bent jet path, noise only on the outer edge and the widening rolling tip; emissive with face shading (top 1.0, sides 0.78-0.86, bottom 0.62)
flame_tongue.shape: s = distance to the centreline / r(age); filled if s <= core (always; the core shrinks only in the last 25 % of the tip) or 1 - s + edgeNoise(k) * n > 0, n = 0.65 vnoise(9 q, scroll 9 m/s up) + 0.35 vnoise(20 q, 16 m/s); edgeNoise(k) = edgeNoise * (0.35 + 0.65 smooth((k - 0.35) / 0.65)) (calm at the nozzle, rolling at the tip)
flame_tongue.radiusLaw: r = r0 + (r1 - r0) k^1.4 + tipBulge * smooth((k - 0.7) / 0.3), k = age / life (max 0.30 m); the tip's edge noise adds tipLick * smooth((k - 0.75) / 0.25): the rolling tip breaks into licking tongues
flame_tongue.centreline: ballistic path of fuel emitted at t - age from the nozzle pose at that time (speed, drag, gravity), 40 samples; held >= 0.6 r above the ground (it splashes and runs along the ground)
flame_tongue.colour: v4: ramp(kk), kk = min(0.8, 0.12 k + 0.55 s + 0.18 k^2 +- 4 %): white-yellow core, bright yellow-orange body, orange edge; red-orange (kk 0.95) ONLY on a flickering 30 % of the outer fringe voxels (s > 0.9) in the last 22 % of the tip (re-rolled 12x/s); HDR gain 1 + 0.35 (1 - kk); no dark red / maroon anywhere

smoke.note: starts AFTER the flame (age > life) and 0.3 m above its tip, rising 1.8 m/s (never inside the flame volume); first 12 % of its life dark orange embers, then grey-black; core 0.15, noise 0.9, threshold 0.45: thin broken wisps; lit, not emissive, in the engine

flame_tongue.engine: proposed FX volume kind 3 (flame jet): centreline points + radii (or emitter pose history) and age as uniforms; ray-march the 5 cm grid inside the tube's AABB like fx_volume (same DDA), surface cube faces shaded

flame_volume.superseded: v2 (0.25 m volume) replaced by flame_tongue (v3, owner feedback)
flame_volume.look: voxelised density volume like the explosions (shaders/include/fx_volume.glsl / fx_volume_frag.glsl): world-aligned 0.25 m voxel grid (0.5 m far, same LOD rule), cells drawn where density > 0, colour = fireColour(k)
flame_volume.density: d(q) = max_i (1 - |q - c_i| / r_i) + noiseAmp * (0.6 vnoise(2.2 q - 4t y) + 0.3 vnoise(5 q - 7t y)) - thr(k_i);  thr = threshold + 0.35 k^2 (flame), smokeThreshold + 0.5 s (smoke)
flame_volume.centreline: c_i = ballistic position of fuel emitted at t - age_i from the nozzle pose AT THAT TIME (speed, drag, gravity), clamped to 0.15 m above the ground (splash); after life it continues as smoke (rise, FX_WIND drift); r_i grows sqrt(age / life) from radius[0] to radius[1], then to smokeRadius
flame_volume.k: k = age_i / life of the closest centreline sample (+ 0.35 (1 - shape) toward the rim, +-6 % per-voxel jitter: the MagicaVoxel colour variation of fx_volume_frag)
flame_volume.engine: proposed FX volume kind 3 (flame jet): uniforms = nozzle position / direction history as N centreline points (or the emitter pose + sweep rate), age; bounds = the centreline AABB + r

flame_smoke.drift: FX_WIND (0.55, 0, 0.25) m/s, as the volume smoke
flame_smoke.note: one smoke voxel per 3 flame voxels

ground_fire.v3: drawn with the flame_tongue voxels (5 cm): every point where the jet reaches the ground makes a pool of radius pool.radius; column height pool.height * (1 - d) * flicker noise; same ramp capped at 0.78 (bright yellow base, orange tips; no red)
ground_fire.seeds: flame voxels hitting the ground merge into pools on a 0.25 m world grid (the explosion / building voxel size)
ground_fire.color: same fireColour ramp, column base k = 0.2, top k = 0.85; embers (#ff6a1e, 0.06 m) at the base for the last 2 s

smoke.column: dark smoke voxels 0.25 m rising 1.5 m/s, 4-6 m high, drift FX_WIND

ground_fire.engine: proposed FX volume kind 2 (ground fire) in fx_volume.glsl: origin = pool centre, B.x = radius, B.w = strength (seeds), B.z seed; density = disc * flicker noise, like wreckDensity but low
ground_fire.gameplay: a pool burns corpses inside its radius (corpse rot stops) and damages zombies standing in it; the light (#ff8a3a, 6 m) also lights the night scene

corpse_burn.note: a corpse inside a ground_fire pool: dark char tint over 3 s (multiply #2a2520), then the corpse dissolves with the canopy voxel dissolve (MILITARY_ANIMS 2.3.3) over 2.5 s, leaving a 0.25 m ash decal (#3a3633)

pilot.when: flamer alive and gun in hands (not slung, not dropped)

cut_sparks.emitter: tool tip (tool_torch socket 'tip'), on while a clip with stream:'cut_sparks' plays

hammer_hit.at: tool tip at the tool_hit event

hose.note: catenary-like sag; drawn as a chain of voxels every 0.045 m; while the gun is dropped the hose follows it (max length 1.25 m, else hidden)
